description: github: Pull Requests. GET /v1/github/user/pull-requests. Get public pull requests authored by a GitHub user. Filter by created date with since and until. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cursor.description: Cursor from the previous response. Defaults to 1.

handle.description: GitHub username/handle of the user you want pull requests for

since.description: Only return pull requests created on or after this date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

until.description: Only return pull requests created on or before this date. Use YYYY-MM-DD.

name: github_user_pull_requests
